feature.action_mapping_note: No exact action-name match; inspect candidates and engine implementation before authoring.

intent.user_goal: Use External Libraries View as part of a realistic IntelliJ IDEA workflow.
intent.transcript_requirement: Treat this capability as available only when the transcript requires its visible IntelliJ interaction/result.
intent.when_to_use: Use this feature file when the transcript maps to External Libraries View.
intent.when_not_to_use: Do not substitute a conceptually related control when the visible interaction differs.

ui_contract.required_visibility: The registered passive/composite capability must be visible through its related canonical IntelliJ actions when a lesson depends on it.
ui_contract.before_state: The simulator starts from the course package baseline plus cumulative replayed IntelliJ actions.
ui_contract.interaction: Inspect candidate actions and engine source; do not invent an action.
ui_contract.after_state: The registered passive/composite capability must be visible through its related canonical IntelliJ actions when a lesson depends on it.
ui_contract.focus_and_scroll: Keep the active control/result/code/command visible without replay shaking.
ui_contract.highlight_rule: Clickable controls use the shared persistent blue boundary. Code/SQL/text uses shared flat line emphasis. IntelliJ terminal current commands use yellow command emphasis.
ui_contract.explanation_rule: Explanation UI is parent-owned/global; never create a competing explanation card.

input_contract.parameters: No exact action.data keys inferred for this feature; inspect source before supplying parameters.
input_contract.destructive_note: No destructive behavior inferred from the canonical action name.

state_contract.user_preferences: User-controlled layout/theme/persistent preferences must not be reset by lesson replay unless explicitly changed.

transcript_matching.decision_rule: Match the visible interaction and expected UI result, then confirm the canonical action/handler.

authoring_steps: Confirm the transcript really uses this visible IntelliJ feature.
Read this exact feature file before writing action.data.
Use canonical actions when present and inspect the handler excerpt/search token.
Do not invent parameters not read by the handler.
Ensure the lesson produces a visible UI result.
Validate direct-jump replay from a clean load.
lesson_authoring.missing_feature_rule: If the transcript requires behavior beyond this file and no engine action/UI supports it, mark it missing and upgrade the master simulator before building the downstream lesson.

replay_and_quality.checkpoint_note: No checkpoint engine yet; current player replays all earlier IntelliJ actions.
replay_and_quality.semantic_target_note: No class/method semantic anchor resolver yet; typeCode supports textual marker/position.

regression_expectations: Feature file remains present while capability/action remains supported.
Visible software-owned UI remains deterministic under replay.

microscopic_contract.behavior_summary: Passive/composite capability; resolve through candidate actions and source.
microscopic_contract.project_effect_note: Documentation classification only. projectImpact=build|temporary|inspect is NOT runtime-enforced yet.

replay_contract.current_runtime: app.js stepsThrough() collects all earlier IntelliJ actions and sendSeekNow() passes them via SIM_SEEK; IntelliJ seek() reset()s then replays them.
replay_contract.historical_action_behavior: Earlier actions run with replayingHistory=true; final action is current.
replay_contract.focus_safety: Historical fidelity inputs suppress autofocus; typeCode follows current focus lines.
replay_contract.semantic_anchor_support: not_implemented; textual marker available for typeCode

limitations_and_non_assumptions: Catalog presence is not pixel-perfect JetBrains parity.
Do not assume projectImpact/checkpoints/semantic anchors exist yet.
Do not create a second explanation box.
